De-Panther/unity-webxr-export "WebXR Export" (Apache-2.0, ~1.2k stars; based on Mozilla Unity WebXR/WebVR Exporter, Apache-2.0; README + WebXR-APIs-support read 2026-06-15) + companions immersive-web/webxr-input-profiles & De-Panther/webxr-input-profiles-loader (referenced as the mapping mechanism). METHODOLOGY ONLY, no package/code bundled, Unity not run -> unity-webxr-bridge.md. Adds the Unity-C#/XR -> WebGL/WebXR BRIDGE ARCHITECTURE under the existing setup SOP: WebXR Device API -> Unity Display + Input XR Subsystems (stereo + poses, so the standard Unity XR stack incl. XRI runs on top); WebXR Gamepads Module -> Unity New Input System incl. haptics (the reason Active Input Handling must include the New Input System); Unity XR SDK first-class since export v0.20.0. WebXR Input Profiles controller mapping: input sources report most-specific-first profile IDs, the Input Profiles Loader resolves to a controller model + gamepad button/axis layout that XRI binds to, with a mandatory generic-profile fallback chain (the concrete fix for the hardcoded-controller red flag) + the public Input Profile Viewer for inspecting mappings. WebXR Hand Input -> Unity XR Hands package (Unity-side joints/interactors, distinct from the existing Babylon/A-Frame 25-joint JS notes), hands+controllers coexist, pinch/poke via XRI. Bridge constraints: URP supported / Built-in RP dropped at v0.20.0 (re-addable 0.22+ only by disabling Display Submodule); AR module + passthrough supported but Hit-Test is VIEWER-SPACE WebXR only, NOT AR Foundation (ARF is roadmap); WebXR Polyfill fallback ships for non-WebXR browsers. Gate-0: existing rules.md had the De-Panther EDITOR SETUP/BUILD 9-step SOP + JS-stack (three/A-Frame/Babylon/@react-three/xr) WebXR + JS hand-tracking notes; the bridge architecture, the WebXR Input Profiles registry/loader controller-binding mechanism, the WebXR-Hand-Input->XR-Hands Unity mapping, and the bridge render/AR constraints were all net-new. No em-dashes.
